name: (Grim Matchstick) CUPHEAD Fight!
desc:
⚠️ DISCLAIMER:
This game is also not created with AI.
This game is a recreation allowing you to fight bosses made with the love of cuphead.
This is an unofficial fan-made recreation of Cuphead. All rights to Cuphead and its original characters belong to Studio MDHR.

🎲 CUPHEAD FIGHT! ☕

Step into the world of Cuphead and challenge yourself against iconic bosses in this Roblox recreation!

⚔️ BATTLE BOSSES – Face off against challenging bosses, each with unique attacks and patterns!

🎯 DODGE & ATTACK – Avoid deadly attacks, fight back, and survive!

🏆 MASTER EVERY FIGHT – Learn boss patterns, improve your skills, and conquer every battle!

🚧 COMING SOON:
• More Bosses
• New Abilities
• More Content & Improvements

🎨 ICON BY: EJO

⭐ Enjoying the game? Leave a like and favorite to support future updates!

llm.loop: choose a boss -> dodge patterns and shoot back with friends -> beat bosses
llm.instructions: learn boss patterns, dodge and attack
unique: fan recreation of a well-known console boss-rush game
llm.thumbnails: recognisable cartoon cup character and vegetable boss art
llm.complexity_notes: hand-recreated boss patterns and 2D-style art in 3D; no monetisation
